description: Define the small stable Node, Edge, unresolved-call, and graph JSON contracts that parser tasks will use.
scope: Add src/living_graph/model.py with Node and Edge data structures
Use docs/data-contracts.md as the source of truth
acceptanceCriteria: Node and Edge contracts expose stable ids, names, source paths, types, and resolved flags; paths normalize to forward slashes; unresolved calls have a distinct unresolved node type.
constraints: Do not parse Robot Framework files in this task.
Do not parse Python AST in this task.
Do not add graph rendering code.
Keep the implementation small and dependency-free.

subtasks.title: Create Node and Edge contracts
subtasks.summary: Implement simple serializable Node and Edge contracts in src/living_graph/model.py.
scope: Define Node with id, name, type, source_path, fan_in default 0, fan_out default 0
Define Edge with caller_id, callee_id, caller_name, callee_name, source_path, resolved
Provide a to_dict helper or equivalent serialization method
Normalize source paths to forward slashes
dataExamples: Robot test case node type: test_case.
Robot user keyword node type: user_keyword.
Python library keyword node type: library_keyword.
instructions: Write tests/test_model.py first using the examples from docs/data-contracts.md.
Run python -m pytest tests/test_model.py -q and confirm failure.

subtasks.title: Represent unresolved calls
subtasks.summary: Add a tiny helper or constructor behavior for unresolved keyword call nodes and edges.
scope: Ensure unresolved callee nodes use type unresolved
Ensure unresolved edges set resolved to false
Keep resolved Robot/Python edges resolved true
dataExamples: Unresolved Robot call Missing Keyword gets id unresolved::Missing Keyword.
Edge to Missing Keyword has resolved == false.
instructions: Add the failing unresolved-call contract test first.
Run python -m pytest tests/test_model.py -q and confirm failure.
Implement only the minimal unresolved helper/behavior.

businessRules: Use forward-slash project-relative paths in ids and source_path fields.
Node ids are stable strings formatted as {source_path}::{name}, except unresolved ids which use unresolved::{name}.
Keep contracts JSON-serializable without custom encoders.
